html:
SMTO-BOOT-0019 — The installer can't find Conda to check your setup

GUID: b192de4b-b5ad-4881-ac92-cc3823119706
Slug: boot-conda-missing
Domain: BOOT · Subsystem: boot

What happened

  • You asked the installer only to check an existing setup, but it couldn't find Conda, the tool that holds the model software. Check-only mode never installs anything, so nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open a terminal where Conda works (conda --version prints a version number), and run the check again from that terminal. The installer finds Conda through the current terminal or in miniforge3, miniconda3 or anaconda3 in your home folder.
  2. If Conda is installed somewhere else, set CONDA_HOME to the full path of that folder, the one that contains bin/conda, and run the check again. CONDA_HOME tells the installer exactly where Conda is; when it is set, the installer looks only there.
  3. If vLLM was never installed on this computer, run the installer without --verify-only, for example ./src/vllm/install-vllm.sh vllm; it installs Conda for you. Check-only mode needs an existing setup, while the normal install creates Conda and the environment from scratch.

What success looks like

  • The installer prints "Using Conda:" followed by a folder and goes on to check your environment.

If it still fails

  • Copy the full terminal output, including the SMTO-BOOT-0019 line and the Error reference line, plus the result of conda --version, and send it to the person who set up vLLM on this computer. If someone else set it up, ask them where Conda is before starting a fresh install.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • install-vllm.sh --verify-only found no executable conda at CONDA_HOME/bin/conda (when CONDA_HOME is set) or, otherwise, via CONDA_EXE, PATH, ~/miniforge3, ~/miniconda3 or ~/anaconda3, and verify-only mode never bootstraps Miniforge.

What this means

  • Verify-only installation mode cannot locate a usable Conda executable through the supported selection paths. Verify-only mode exits without bootstrapping Conda or creating an environment. The failure does not establish whether Conda is installed elsewhere outside the supported search locations.

Why this can happen

  • Verify-only installation mode cannot locate a usable Conda executable through the supported selection paths.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected CONDA_HOME/PATH and keep verify-only separate from installation.

How to fix it

  • Set CONDA_HOME to the absolute root of the existing Conda installation (the directory containing bin/conda), or run from a shell where CONDA_EXE or conda resolves, then rerun install-vllm.sh --verify-only with the environment name. Run without --verify-only only if a fresh Miniforge bootstrap and new environment are intended.
  • Set CONDA_HOME to an existing supported Conda installation or use the documented installation flow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Point CONDA_HOME at the intended existing Conda installation, or deliberately use the separate installation flow.

How to verify the fix

  • Verification locates the intended existing Conda executable.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Verify-only mode exits without bootstrapping Conda or creating an environment.
  • The failure does not establish whether Conda is installed elsewhere outside the supported search locations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
